title: Callaway Golf 2023 Paradym Individual Iron Right (52° Gap Wedge, Graphite, Light Flex) - New

comparisons.notes: New Callaway Paradym (2023) individual iron, right hand, graphite; one price for all lofts 4 iron through 52° wedge; available.
Same Paradym individual iron product (4H89 right-hand family), lofts 4 iron through 52° wedge at one price; available.

writeup: Woot has a brand-new Callaway 2023 Paradym 52-degree gap wedge, right-handed with a graphite light-flex shaft, for $79.99. Golf Galaxy and Dick's Sporting Goods both sell Paradym single irons for $171.43, so this is about $91 less. The Paradym uses a hollow-body design with a forged 455 face. Woot showed only one left.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN B0BLTB9FXC verified by checker as Callaway 2023 Paradym 52° gap wedge RH graphite light flex, UPC 194518857178, MPN 4H892042H1006.
